newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - July 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - July 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

A meeting of the Bangladesh-India Joint River Commission begins in Dhaka on July 19 to review implementation of the recent agreement on Ganges water sharing and discuss sharing of other common rivers.
Italian Deputy Foreign Minister Senator Patrizia Toia arrived in Dhaka on a three-day visit to Bangladesh.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Monday left Hamburg for U.S.A. ending her three-day visit to Germany.
Chittagong Urea Fertiliser Limited resumed its production on Tuesday after seven-and-a-half month's closure owing to gas shortage.
Country's new export and import policies will be announced shortly, said Commerce and Industries Minister Tofael Ahmed.
Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) will soon undergo a major structural change.
The government on Tuesday said some three million people had been affected by the current flooding.
Over 700 workers and employees of a Korean factory in the Dhaka Export Processing Zone (DEPZ) have been sued and 92 of them terminated following a labour unrest in the firm. REUTER
